Apology Generator

Build a sincere, structured apology from your situation — acknowledge, take responsibility, make amends, and promise change.

Your structured apology will appear here.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the person's name and what happened.
  2. Choose the situation type and tone.
  3. Generate, then copy or download your apology.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it work?

Enter who you are apologizing to, what happened, and your tone — the tool writes a complete apology with all four parts.

What tones are available?

Sincere, Lighthearted, or Formal — pick the tone that fits the situation.

Can I copy or download it?

Yes — copy it or download it as a text file to send however you like.
